hypothesis: The v005 rules, unchanged, keep positive net expectancy on a universe extended with newer high-beta coins (HYPE and peers), measured only on live paper data from the freeze date onward.
rulesChosenFrom: Identical to trend-daily-v005; only the universe changes. HYPE was added at the user's request; daily correlation analysis (495 days of perp data) showed HYPE moves with the whole market (0.5-0.6) and no HYPE-specific cluster on Binance, so peers were chosen as liquid post-2023 Binance spot listings, not by correlation.
survivorshipNote: EOSUSDT and MATICUSDT are dropped because Binance spot no longer trades them. A coin trades once it has 20 daily closes.
execution: Signal on the daily close (00:00 UTC); fill at the next day's open. One position per symbol, equal size. Long only.
noRetuning: No historical test is claimed: most added coins have under 3 years of history. Results count only from live paper. v005 continues unchanged in parallel.

amendments.change: HYPEUSDT daily bars and alert prices come from Hyperliquid spot HYPE/USDC (@107) instead of Binance spot.
amendments.reason: Binance HYPE spot has about 15 daily closes, below the 20 the entry rule needs, so v006 could not trade HYPE. Hyperliquid spot has daily closes since Nov 2024 and is HYPE's main market. Rules, universe and acceptance criteria are unchanged; the amendment lands on the forward start date, before any v006 trade.
